The implementation is complete and fully verified. Per the execution protocol, I've edited only files in the worktree within the declared locks — the Shiki goal loop owns commit/push/PR delivery.

## Result
- **Goal/task:** G-20260801T085710527889Z-5ec41eba / T-20260801T085710529159Z-575d4080
- **Role:** Implementer (Claude Code, headless dispatch)
- **Status:** complete (implemented + verified in-worktree; loop owns delivery)

## What changed
**DEFECT A — verdict-aware repair gating** (`scripts/shiki_loop.py`)
- `goal_loop_step` now resolves the CCA verdict VALUE read-only from durable CI evidence (`_resolve_cca_verdict`: `gh run list` the CCA workflow → `gh run download --name shiki-cca-evidence` → read `cca-verdict.json`) — only when the `CCA verdict` check is red on an impl PR — and passes it as a new pure `cca_verdict` param into `decide_task_action` (keeps the engine pure).
- New pure `_cca_verdict_stop`: `needs_guardian`→`stop_guardian`, `blocked`→`stop_blocked`, `complete`-vs-red-check→distinct `stop_blocked`, unresolvable→distinct fail-closed `stop_blocked` — none dispatch a repair or consume an attempt. `repair_required`/`insufficient_evidence` still dispatch + increment, but the CCA verdict check is stripped from the repair items (mirroring POLICY_GATE) so no packet ever names it; `_dispatch_repair` names the verdict's findings instead. Resolution is read-only and never raises (any error → unresolvable). POLICY_GATE handling untouched.

**DEFECT B — push the evidence the task cites** (`scripts/shiki_loop.py`)
- `rerun_cca` and `dispatch_repair` now call the (unchanged) `_sync_state_to_branch` after their ledger append. The `dispatch_repair` sync sits *after* the head-movement guard so the evidence commit can't mask a no-op repair.

## Checklist status
- **Skill Gate:** tdd (tests drive real `decide_task_action` + real effectors + real resolver) ✓; code-review is the loop-owned pre-PR gate (ADR 0011) — cannot self-invoke, did rigorous self-review ✓
- **Tests added:** `tests/test_loop_verdict_gating.py` (26 cases: every verdict branch, unresolvable, counter-unchanged vs increment, POLICY_GATE byte-for-byte, DEFECT-B transitive evidence on-branch); `test_shiki_goal_loop.sh` needs_guardian→Guardian-stop-not-repair case; `test_shiki_adversarial_state.sh` "no emittable packet names the CCA verdict check as its only item" case.

- `test_shiki_goal_loop.sh`, `test_shiki_adversarial_state.sh`, `test_shiki_governance_evidence.sh`, `validate_shiki.py --target .` → all pass (the exact task `test_command`)
- `git status`: only the 4 locked files changed (`scripts/shiki_loop.py`, `tests/test_loop_verdict_gating.py`, `scripts/test_shiki_goal_loop.sh`, `scripts/test_shiki_adversarial_state.sh`); the task-mirror change is the loop's own pre-existing dispatch bookkeeping.
